Assignment Title: Fix Unboxing NullPointerException in E-Commerce Price Query System

Assignment Question:
An e-commerce product catalog system queries item prices stored in a HashMap<String, Double>. When a user searches for an item missing from the inventory, map.get() returns null. Assigning this result directly to a primitive double triggers an automatic unboxing NullPointerException at runtime. Fix the editable section to prevent crashing and print 'Invalid Input' for missing keys.

Input Format: Line 1 contains n (number of items). The next n lines contain 'name price'. The final line contains the item query string.
Output Format: Formatted string 'Price: <value>' or 'Invalid Input'.
